zh.title: 购物按钮为什么突然跳动？
zh.scenario: 商品列表打开后，补货提示异步插入列表上方。用户还没点击，「加入购物车」按钮就被挤到了下方。
zh.metricPrompt: 这条反馈应该先查哪个指标？

metricFeedback.LCP: LCP 关注可视区最大的内容元素何时绘制。此处按钮已经可见，问题出在位置突然变化。
metricFeedback.INP: INP 关注交互之后页面多久给出视觉反馈。这里位置变化发生在点击之前。
metricFeedback.CLS: 选对了。提示条插入时挤动了已经可见的按钮，这是 CLS 捕捉的意外布局位移。

zh.change: 新版给提示条预留位置，再填入相同的补货信息。
zh.sample: 合成实验数据。每版同一移动视口、网络限速、冷缓存与操作，各跑 3 次，取中位数。

loading.choice: 主内容加载更快，说明按钮跳动已经修复。
loading.feedback: 主内容加载时间和控件位置是两项不同的观察。回到 CLS 那一行，再结合按钮的位置变化判断。

validation.choice: 受控实验中位移减小，继续查真实用户的布局稳定性。
validation.feedback: 正确。CLS 从 0.19 降到 0.03，支持实验条件下布局更稳定。记录按钮是否仍有位移，再按移动端和桌面端分别比较现场 CLS 的第 75 百分位。

universal.choice: 三次复测足以确认所有用户都已达标。
universal.feedback: 这组实验只覆盖一种环境。真实用户的设备、网络和访问过程各异，仍需核对现场分布。

en.title: Why does the cart button jump?
en.scenario: A restock banner loads above the product list after the page opens. It pushes the Add to cart button down before the user clicks anything.
en.metricPrompt: Which metric should you investigate first?

metricFeedback.LCP: LCP tracks when the largest visible content element renders. The button is already visible and suddenly changes position.
metricFeedback.INP: INP tracks how quickly the page responds visually to an interaction. The button moves before the user interacts.
metricFeedback.CLS: Correct. The banner moves an already visible button. CLS captures that unexpected layout shift.

en.change: The new build reserves room for the banner, then fills it with the same restock information.
en.sample: Synthetic lab data. Median of 3 runs per build with the same mobile viewport, network throttling, cold cache, and interaction.

loading.choice: Main content loads faster, so the button no longer jumps.
loading.feedback: Content loading time and button position measure different things. Use the CLS row together with the observed position change.

validation.choice: Shifts decreased in the lab. Check layout stability for real users next.
validation.feedback: Correct. CLS drops from 0.19 to 0.03 under these test conditions. Record whether the button still shifts, then compare the 75th percentile of field CLS for mobile and desktop separately.

universal.choice: Three retests confirm that every user now meets the target.
universal.feedback: The experiment covers one environment. Real users have different devices, networks, and browsing behavior. Check the field distribution next.
